text: c, Six BESO topology cases with perspective and plan views. I–V use two to six supports and central-ring loading, with local sector moments of 200, 133.33, 100, 80 and 66.67 MN m, respectively. VI uses three supports and loading at the P1 rim with a 400 MN m moment. Red arrows denote the downward force (24.5 MN), orange double arrows denote moment axes, and blue triangles mark fixed supports. V/V₀ is the retained volume fraction. The central-case values are local sector moments rather than a common global resultant. The scale bar represents 20 m.
